individual_findings: Individually reviewed 36 existing controls, all three presets and three required wording controls. Preserves four configured product pickers/current-product inclusion and cards/inline/grid layouts. One shared item calculation/render path replaces copied current/companion markup; duplicate native products are removed, only actual available variants with valid native minimum quantities and required selected selling plans enter the subtotal/payload. Locale native POST and contiguous indexed items fields use the existing cart handler instead of copied fetch/fake global cart events. Actual owning product form drives included current variant/quantity/plan. No automatic enrollment of a companion requiring unselected purchase options; its named native product link and explicit message remain. Native image/alt, empty/editor ownership, wrapping/shrinking and neutral new offer copy repaired; saved merchant offers retained with honest schema explanation.

individual_findings: Individually reviewed 76 existing controls, all three presets and four required wording controls. Native form works before enhancement; selection checkboxes appear only when their controller can keep disabled payload fields and subtotal synchronized. Current-product exclusion/deduplication precedes manual limit. Totals contain only actual eligible selected quantities/native prices and allocations; unavailable items no longer inflate the initial total. Display discount percentage is retained as an explicitly potential offer without subtracting unapplied discounts from subtotal. Native compare-at savings and show-price/show-compare/show-savings gates remain faithful after updates. Shared cart handling replaces copied JSON add/global fake events. Preserves cards/inline/compact, all IDs and responsive/color/typography controls, fixes named group/controls, native wrapper ownership and truthful empty/editor/new preset copy.
